long_biography.plain_text:
Insurance was Ángel Del Toro's first line of work in the United States. He and Elena learned the trade before establishing Del Toro Insurance in Miami; the agency was incorporated in 1997 and began serving clients the following year. Its initial strength was automobile cover for South Florida customers, with a focus on personal advice in the community that had welcomed them. Del Toro became the company's president and chief executive while Elena took a senior leadership role.

As the business developed, it added home, commercial, life and health policies and expanded through franchises. The model offers experienced agents a route to running their own agencies with support from the Del Toro brand and systems. Its founders have described the transition from employee to business owner as part of the company's purpose. Ángel continues to lead the insurance enterprise, while the family's other private holdings and the precise division of ownership remain outside the published account of the business.
